title: Hugging Face LLM Course
description: Free course on working with large language models, covering transformer fundamentals, fine-tuning, reasoning models and building LLM-based applications.
quality_notes: Maintained by the library's authors, so it reflects that ecosystem's tooling choices. Course content in this area is revised frequently.
why_useful: One of the few free, structured treatments of LLM application work that goes beyond prompting tips into fine-tuning and evaluation.
learning_outcomes: Apply parameter-efficient fine-tuning to a small model
Evaluate an LLM-based system rather than eyeballing outputs

title: Prompt engineering overview
description: Vendor documentation on designing prompts, covering clear instructions, examples, structured output, chain-of-thought prompting and systematic iteration.
quality_notes: Vendor documentation for one model family. The general principles transfer; specific syntax and behaviour claims do not necessarily apply to other providers.
why_useful: Treats prompting as an engineering practice with iteration and evaluation, rather than a list of tricks, which is the framing that survives contact with a real system.
learning_outcomes: Write instructions specific enough to be reliably followed
Iterate on a prompt against a test set rather than by impression
